texts.orig: 3.2 Boundary conditions

texts.label: text
texts.orig: As in Subsection 2.2, the coefficients c i and the parameter λ can be used to satisfy homogeneous boundary conditions. Two boundary conditions for both θ = 0 and θ = ω give a homogeneous linear system of 4 equations which has a non-trivial solution iff the determinant vanishes. This condition is used to find again a countable number of values of λ . Let us sketch this approach for the case of Dirichlet boundary conditions and λ = 0.
